Description:
The Political Youth is a non-partisan civic media and education platform built to make politics understandable, governance accessible, and citizenship actionable for the next generation.

We exist because political awareness today is often loud but shallow. Information is abundant, yet understanding is rare. Young citizens consume headlines, reels, and outrage cycles — but rarely gain structured clarity on how systems actually work. The Political Youth bridges that gap.

Our work sits at the intersection of media, civic literacy, and leadership development.

Through research-backed podcasts, visual explainers, structured frameworks, and civic learning tools, we decode public policy, power structures, institutions, and decision-making processes. We simplify without oversimplifying. We analyze without ideological bias. We prioritize critical thinking over partisanship.

Our audience includes Gen Z, Millennials, educators, young professionals, founders, and emerging leaders who want depth over noise and competence over commentary.

We focus on three core outcomes:

• Civic Intelligence – Understanding how governance systems function in practice
• Analytical Thinking – Evaluating policy, institutions, and power with clarity
• Leadership Readiness – Translating awareness into responsible civic action

The Political Youth does not advocate for political parties. We advocate for political literacy.

In an era of misinformation and polarized narratives, we believe democracy requires informed participants — not passive consumers. Our mission is to democratize access to structured political understanding and equip young citizens with the tools to question responsibly, engage thoughtfully, and lead ethically.

We are building more than a media platform.
We are building civic infrastructure for the future.

Founded in 1999 as Power Music Cassette Company, PMCC Multimedia Pvt Ltd began its journey with a deep passion for preserving and evolving the rich cultural heritage of India through music. However, we always envisioned taking this rich cultural heritage and modernizing it in a way that resonated with the new generation while keeping the essence intact. PMCC Multimedia Pvt Ltd was one of the first companies to introduce Rajasthani devotional music infused with modern sound, creating a unique genre that became instantly popular among listeners.

From the very start, we focused on the principle of preserving authenticity, which was especially important in devotional music. The spiritual aspect of the music needed to remain untouched, but our goal was to blend it with contemporary musical elements that could appeal to listeners of all ages. We incorporated modern instruments, new production techniques, and innovative arrangements to create a fresh sound without losing the essence of traditional spirituality.

We are solving a major problem that persists across all events, where photographs are not shared timely with the guests of the event – be it a wedding event, a conference or a small get together. Statistically speaking, a person spends countless hours in sorting photos, segregating unique photos for unique guests, and then uploading them in separate folders to share separate links with friends or guests.
Imagine a world where all of this is automated and all you have to do is upload photos, generate a secure link and share that link with all your friends or guests for them to download their photos in a snap of a finger!
Wouldn’t that be brilliant?

The platform also features a workflow by which guests can request to add or delete photos from the album which the host can approve or disallow.

MyFotoCart simplifies the overall value chain for photo sharing while having a strong focus on privacy, speed and security.

Name: Network of Women in Media, India
Description:
The Network of Women in Media, India (NWMI) is a vibrant forum for women in media professions to share information and resources, exchange ideas, uphold media standards and ethics, and promote gender equality within the media as well as society. Launched in January 2002, it has been steadily growing and currently has a membership of about 1000 media women across the country, working in multiple languages. Local networks currently exist in 17 places in different parts of India.

Over the years the network has emerged as a group that takes strong public positions on journalists’ rights and media ethics, while standing alongside women mediapersons in various struggles for justice – both individual and collective.

As a collective endeavour – informal, decentralised and non-hierarchical, with no institutional affiliation, infrastructure, secretariat, office-bearers, staff or funds – the NWMI's evolution and potential impact depends on the participation and contribution of everyone involved. Decision-making has been largely transparent and consensus-based, following extensive deliberation.

The periodic national-level meetings of the NWMI, held in different parts of the country almost every year since 2002, have become eagerly anticipated features of network activity. Each meeting is planned and organised by volunteer members of local networks, who somehow make the time and summon up the energy and enthusiasm to do so in the midst of their own professional work and other preoccupations.

Jagran Film Festival is one of the world’s largest travelling film festivals rooted in India.

JFF fosters a culture of cinema and creates a stage where film makers and movie buffs come together to experience the world of cinema. Audiences get an opportunity to interact with national and international cast and crew, listen to their in-conversation and participate in question and answer session.

We receive over 7000 entries every year across 72 countries. All the eligible films are previewed by country’s one of the best preview panelists (lot of them chosen from the National film awards panel) and through a selection process, handpicked 500 films are screened in the festival over 100 days.

JFF is inaugurated by the Ministry of Information and Broadcasting, Government of India at New Delhi and travels across 11 states of India, which constitutes over 500 million people.

Through the competition process, judged by one of the best panel of judges under various categories, we honor film makers and artists for their outstanding work and achievements in their respective fields of cinema with awards and cash prize during the award night at the Tinsel Town Mumbai.

Description:
ଚାଷୀ ସଂଳାପ | Chasi Sanglapa – KV Dialogue
“I’m Ready to Drive Meaningful Change!”

ଚାଷୀ ସଂଳାପ (Chasi Sanglapa) is the Odia edition of the widely acclaimed KV Dialogue – KhetiValah Dialogues (AgriTalks) — a unique platform dedicated to promoting agriculture, rural development, and the upliftment of farmers.

ଆମ ଦୃଷ୍ଟିକୋଣ | Our Vision:

"କୃଷିର କଥା, ଚାଷୀଙ୍କର ଭାଷାରେ" — Let agriculture be discussed in the farmer’s own language.

This initiative is built on the belief that real change begins when farmers are heard, respected, and empowered in their own cultural and linguistic context.

ଉଦ୍ଦେଶ୍ୟ | Our Purpose: 
Chasi Sanglapa aims to connect traditional agricultural wisdom with modern innovations, encouraging open and inspiring discussions among:

ଚାଷୀ (Farmers)
କୃଷି ଉଦ୍ୟମୀ (Agri-entrepreneurs)
ନୀତି ନିର୍ମାତା (Policymakers)
ନବପ୍ରବର୍ତ୍ତକ (Innovators)
ଗ୍ରାମୀଣ ସମୁଦାୟ (Rural Communities)

Through inspiring dialogues and expert insights, this platform helps create a space for learning, sharing, and collaboration across Odisha and beyond.

ମୁଖ୍ୟ ବିଷୟବସ୍ତୁ | Key Focus Areas:
 ସସ୍ୟ ବ୍ୟବସ୍ଥାପନା ଓ ଟିକେଇଥିବା କୃଷି ପ୍ରଥା (Sustainable Farming Practices)
 ପରିବର୍ତ୍ତିତ ପାଣିପାଗ ପାଇଁ ଅନୁକୂଳ କୃଷି (Climate-Resilient Agriculture)
 କୃଷି ତନ୍ତ୍ରଜ୍ଞାନ ଓ ନବିନତା (Agri-Tech & Innovation)
 ସରକାରୀ ଯୋଜନା ଓ ନୀତିମାନ୍ୟ (Government Schemes & Policies)
 ଜୈବ କୃଷି, ବଜାର ଯୋଗାଯୋଗ ଓ ଅନ୍ୟାନ୍ୟ (Organic Farming, Market Linkages & More)

Each ଚାଷୀ ସଂଳାପ episode is designed to give voice to the farming community, celebrate their stories, and spark ଜ୍ଞାନ ଓ ଅନୁଭବ ବିନିମୟ (knowledge and experience exchange) — all in our own Odia language.

ଆମ ଲକ୍ଷ୍ୟ | Our Mission:
To build a resilient, innovative, and inclusive agricultural future that empowers Odisha’s farmers and helps India take the lead in global agriculture.

 ଆସନ୍ତୁ, ଏକ ଶକ୍ତିଶାଳୀ କୃଷି ଓ ସ୍ୱାସ୍ଥ୍ୟସମ୍ପନ୍ନ ଜଗତ ଗଢିବା ପାଇଁ ଏକତ୍ର ହେବା।
Let’s unite to build a "Wealthy India and a Healthier Globe."
